subject: anaesthesia
title: Pseudocholinesterase Variants: Dibucaine Number and Steroidal Muscle Relaxants

steps.title: Pseudocholinesterase Deficiency Genetics
steps.tx: **Pseudocholinesterase enzyme genetic variants** dictate prolonged neuromuscular paralysis following standard succinylcholine dosing. The human BCHE gene located on chromosome 3 encodes plasma butyrylcholinesterase. Mutations alter enzyme catalytic efficiency: the typical normal allele is designated Eu, the atypical dibucaine-resistant allele is Ea, the fluoride-resistant allele is Ef, and the silent completely inactive allele is Es.

rows: Normal rapid recovery in 8 to 12 minutes
Severe prolonged paralysis lasting 4 to 8 hours
Total absence of enzyme; paralysis up to 8 to 12 hours

steps.title: Dibucaine Number Laboratory Test
steps.tx: **Dibucaine number laboratory interpretation** measures the percentage of butyrylcholinesterase activity inhibited by the local anaesthetic dibucaine (cinchocaine) under standardized in vitro assay conditions. Normal enzyme is inhibited by 80 percent (dibucaine number 80), heterozygous atypical enzyme exhibits intermediate inhibition (dibucaine number 50 to 60), whereas homozygous atypical enzyme is inhibited by only 20 percent (dibucaine number 20).

left.title: Dibucaine Number (Quality Metric)
points: Reflects the intrinsic catalytic efficiency of the enzyme
Completely independent of total circulating enzyme quantity
Normal is 80; heterozygous is 50 to 60; atypical homozygous is 20

right.title: Enzyme Activity Level (Quantity Metric)
points: Measures absolute circulating enzymatic activity units per liter
Depressed in liver disease, malnutrition, pregnancy, and burns
Produces only mild prolongation of paralysis if dibucaine number is normal

steps.title: Management of Suxamethonium Apnoea
steps.tx: **Management of prolonged suxamethonium apnea** requires patient mechanical ventilation and continuous sedation until neuromuscular function recovers spontaneously. Clinicians must maintain tracheal intubation, verify ventilatory support, administer intravenous sedatives to prevent conscious awareness during paralysis, and monitor the peripheral nerve stimulator; fresh frozen plasma is generally avoided due to transfusion reaction and viral risks.

steps.title: Rocuronium Rapid-Sequence Sizing
steps.tx: **Rocuronium monoquaternary aminosteroid kinetics** provide the fastest onset of any non-depolarizing relaxant. At a standard intubating dose of 0.6 mg/kg (2x ED95), rocuronium produces intubating conditions in 90 seconds. When administered at a rapid sequence induction dose of 1.2 mg/kg (4x ED95), rocuronium establishes excellent intubating conditions within 45 to 60 seconds, directly matching succinylcholine speed without its lethal hyperkalaemic hazards.

steps.title: Vecuronium Pharmacological Profile
steps.tx: **Vecuronium steroidal pharmacology** represents an intermediate-duration, non-depolarizing monoquaternary aminosteroid derived from pancuronium. Administered at 0.1 mg/kg, vecuronium produces intubation conditions in 2.5 to 3 minutes with zero cardiovascular side effects, zero histamine release, and zero vagolytic tachycardia, making it remarkably stable for cardiac surgery.

left.title: Vecuronium Hemodynamics
points: Pristine cardiac stability with zero autonomic ganglia blockade
No muscarinic receptor blockade (no vagolytic tachycardia)
Zero histamine release from mast cells; safe in reactive airways

right.title: Pancuronium Parent Molecule
points: Potent vagolytic blockade of cardiac muscarinic M2 receptors
Prominent tachycardia, hypertension, and catecholamine release
Long duration of action (60 to 90 minutes) prone to residual block

steps.title: Organ Elimination of Aminosteroids
steps.tx: **Elimination pathways of steroidal relaxants** depend predominantly on hepatic metabolism and biliary excretion: vecuronium is cleared 40 to 60 percent by biliary excretion and 20 to 30 percent by renal excretion, producing active 3-hydroxy metabolites that can accumulate during prolonged intensive care infusions. Rocuronium is cleared over 70 percent unchanged by the liver into bile, causing prolonged duration in cirrhosis.

3-hydroxypancuronium causes prolonged paralysis in renal failure

steps.title: Sugammadex Cyclodextrin Reversal
steps.tx: **Sugammadex selective relaxant binding** represents a modified gamma-cyclodextrin molecule with a lipophilic central cavity and a hydrophilic exterior. Administered intravenously, sugammadex encapsulates rocuronium and vecuronium molecules in a tight 1:1 guest-host molecular complex, reducing free plasma concentration to zero and rapidly reversing deep neuromuscular blockade within two to three minutes without anticholinergic side effects.

nodes.label: Inject IV sugammadex (2 to 16 mg/kg depending on block depth)
Creates massive concentration gradient drawing rocuronium from NMJ
Full recovery to TOF ratio >0.9 within 2 to 3 minutes

steps.title: Sugammadex Dosing Thresholds
steps.tx: **Weight-based sugammadex dosing tiers** correspond directly to objective neuromuscular monitoring depth: routine reversal of moderate blockade (reappearance of two twitches on train-of-four) requires 2 mg/kg; deep blockade (zero TOF twitches with 1 to 2 post-tetanic twitches) demands 4 mg/kg; and emergency immediate rescue reversal three minutes following a 1.2 mg/kg rocuronium bolus demands 16 mg/kg.
